latestVersion.changelog:
Avatar Icon Generator — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: Instantly generate animated circular avatar icons from your photos or text for profile pictures.
- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, MP4 file uploads up to 200MB, with automatic AI processing.
- Simple onboarding: connect automatically with a free token if none is set.
- Exports avatars as 1080p MP4 files in 20–40 seconds.
- Features easy commands for editing, status checks, credits, and exporting.
- Ideal for content creators, social media users, and marketers needing fast, custom avatars without graphic design software.
